title: Deprecation Configuration Schema
description: Schema for market deprecation configuration. Deprecation is address-based, not artifact-based, because the same artifact type can be used for both listed and deprecated markets.

addresses.description: Map of market contract addresses (lowercase) to deprecation metadata

deprecated.description: Whether the market is deprecated (must be true)

reason.description: Explanation of why the market is deprecated

alternative.description: Recommended alternative market to use, or null if no alternative

since.description: Version when deprecation was introduced (semantic versioning format)
